title: Planning
chooseBody: Read Markdown and design images where they already live. Atlas does not move or edit these files.
limits: Atlas notices files that change after you open the folder. It does not check earlier changes, files shared with other paths, or secrets inside documents.
empty: No supported documents or images were found.
observationLimit: Files may change before the next check.
findFile: Find a file name or path
historyLimit: Commit history shows the current branch's commits, without uncommitted changes.
comparisonLimit: Code comparison checks the whole repository at the start and end of the period, not each commit.
noMatches: No matching files. Change or clear the search.
partial: Some files or folders were not checked.
folderUnavailable: This folder is unavailable or has changed. Choose it again.
fileChanged: This file changed while you were reading. Refresh to read it again.
fileUnavailable: This file cannot be read now. Refresh or choose another file.
imageUnavailable: This image could not be displayed.
unsupported: This file cannot be displayed here.
noContentSearch: Search matches file and folder names, not file contents.
depthLimit: Some folders exceed the depth limit.
unknownRemaining: The number of unchecked entries is unknown.
unreadable: Entries that could not be checked: {count}
imageLimit: Some images exceed the document preview limit.
checkingSlow: This check is taking longer than expected. Use Refresh folder to try again.
startBody: Open a planning folder to read Markdown documents and design images in one place.
homeStartBody: Make a planning folder inside this folder to write and gather documents, or choose a folder you already have and read it.
homeNote: It goes in {folder}/planning/. A folder you choose is only read.
firstDocumentBody: Type a title and press Enter. The document is created and opens for writing.
firstDocumentNote: Documents are saved as Markdown files in {folder}/planning/.
saveRefused: This file changed somewhere else. Nothing was saved. Copy your text and open the file again.
saveFailed: Could not save this file. Your text is still in the editor.
createFailed: Could not create the planning folder. Check that this folder can be written.
createDocumentFailed: Could not create this document. Check that the planning folder can be written.
browserUnavailable: Open an ontology folder to make a planning folder inside it. Choosing another folder to read works only in the macOS app.
notEditable: This file is not UTF-8, so it cannot be edited here.
importServiceHint: Bring documents from a service such as Notion into the planning folder. It continues in Library.
addFilesAdded: Added {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} to the planning folder.
addFilesLeftBoth: {duplicates, number} already there and {unsupported, number} of an unsupported type were not added.
addFilesLeftDuplicates: {duplicates, plural, one {# file was} other {# files were}} already there and not added.
addFilesLeftUnsupported: {unsupported, plural, one {# file was} other {# files were}} of an unsupported type and not added.
addFilesPartFailed: {failed, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} could not be added. Check that the planning folder can be written.
addFilesNothing: Nothing was added. Only Markdown and images (png, jpg, webp, avif) can be added.
addFilesFailed: Could not add the files. Check that the planning folder can be written.
